title: India registered nearly 3 lakh electric cars in Jan-Oct 2026 (Vahan; GaadiWaadi 2,93,877 with data to 4 Nov; Autocar India's quarterly figures sum to about 2.94 lakh), against just under 2 lakh in all of 2025 (Autocar India 1,95,571; Frost & Sullivan via IBEF). Autocar India counts 3,04,701 from 1 Jan to 9 Nov, which it calls the first calendar year above 3 lakh, and expects 3.5-3.6 lakh by 31 Dec. Shares: Tata 39.7%, Mahindra about 23% (now No. 2, overtaking JSW MG), JSW MG 18.7%, VinFast about 5%; top three about 81%.

Nearly 3 lakh electric cars registered J: https://gaadiwaadi.com/top-10-ev-brands-in-2026-jan-oct-tata-sits-1st-mahindra-moves-up-to-2nd/ (registered 2,93,877 vehicles between January and October as of Vahan data provided till November 4)
All of 2025 ended just under 2 lakh: https://www.ibef.org/news/india-s-electric-car-sales-set-to-cross-3-lakh-units-for-first-time-in-2026 (just under two lakh units sold in 2025)
3,04,701 from 1 Jan to 9 Nov; first cale: https://www.autocarindia.com/car-news/annual-ev-sales-cross-3-lakh-mark-for-the-first-time-in-2026-441297 (3,04,701 EVs have been delivered to customers between January 1 and November 9 in 2026)
3.5-3.6 lakh expected by 31 Dec (Autocar: https://www.autocarindia.com/car-news/annual-ev-sales-cross-3-lakh-mark-for-the-first-time-in-2026-441297 (expected to close CY2026 with estimated record retail sales of 3.5 lakh-3.6 lakh units)
Mahindra No. 2, about 23%, overtaking JS: https://www.autocarindia.com/car-news/annual-ev-sales-cross-3-lakh-mark-for-the-first-time-in-2026-441297 (22.86%; now ranked second, ahead of MG; 19% in CY2025)
